Application Data.NAME: LifeLine Emergency Services
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Quality Assurance Manager, LifeLine Emergency Services, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@lifelineems.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: LifeLine Emergency Services provides emergency medical transportation, including advanced life support and basic life support services, operated by certified paramedics and EMTs. We have a comprehensive quality assurance program and incident reporting system in place to ensure the highest standards of care and compliance with regulatory requirements. Our services are strictly focused on ambulance transport without offering any ancillary services, such as body piercing or cosmetic procedures, to mitigate risks associated with medical malpractice.
